note: Three separate sites strung along about 0.8 mile of forest road, one camping unit each: 064 on Tower Road north of the Swift Run Road and Locust Ridge intersections (toward the fire tower), 065 on Swift Run Road east of Locust Ridge Road, and 066 on Swift Run Road west of Pine Ridge Trail. All are gravel back-ins in the woods; 065 is the levellest, 064's pad and 066's pad and 290-ft driveway are graded moderate. DCNR describes all three as large enough for horse trailers. Fire rings and picnic tables, nothing else. From PA 235 by Water Company Road and Timber Road, about 6 miles. State forest roads are not plowed in winter, and some Bald Eagle roads need 4WD and high clearance: check the route. --Claude
summary: All three site pages re-read: open year round, bookable (nights offered Nov 2026, May and Jul 2027), $10/$15 + $6.50, each 50 ft, 14-ft clearance, back-in gravel. Imagery rendered (leaf-on): 064 a ~15 m clearing at the pin; 065 closed canopy, nothing visible; 066 a ~20 m opening just NW of the pin. Pins match ReserveAmerica and DCNR GIS (TrailerAccess 'Yes' on all three). NHD: unnamed intermittent streams 64 m from 065 and 101 m from 066; none within 200 m of 064.
flags: SPACING / SPLIT: measured from the site coordinates, 064 to 065 is about 750 m, 065 to 066 about 560 m, 064 to 066 about 1.27 km; by road (OSRM) they sit 0.38 and 0.46 mile apart on one continuous route, 064 named Tower Road by the booking page and Swift Run Road by DCNR GIS. The end sites exceed 1 km but share one access road with 065 between them, so no split is recommended; the entry pin is 065, the middle site. Coordinator's call.
066 driveway 'Moderate' (290 ft) and 064/066 'Site Grade: Moderate'; 3DEP at the pins shows under 1 m difference to the mapped driveways, which says nothing about the driveway pitch itself.
Kind of place: 066 carries 'Horse Site'; DCNR GIS notes on all three say 'Large enough for horse trailers' / 'Larger site, suitable for horse trailers'. Single reservable campsites, kept.

No 'RV Site' among the equipment categories on any Bald Eagle site page in this entry (064 and 065 'Tent Site, Trailer Site', 066 'Horse Site, Tent Site, Trailer Site'): by the brief that is keep, flagged.
Waterfront: nearest NHD flowline is an intermittent stream 64 m from 065, beyond 50 m and under canopy; no upgrade lead.
Forest-wide 4WD/high-clearance line; road surface and weight limits unread (Overpass did not answer).
